fullDescription: A frameless light-mode SaaS pricing page in editorial mono-minimal style: warm off-white paper, hairline-divided three-tier cards with an inverted dark Pro tier, indigo accent, a monthly/annual toggle, and a clean comparison table.
prompt:
## Resumo
A frameless, light-mode SaaS pricing page in a refined editorial-minimal style: near-black ink on warm off-white paper, a subtle dotted grain texture, hairline borders everywhere, and a single electric-indigo accent. The page leads with a confident serif-italic headline, a quiet monthly/annual toggle, a three-tier card row where the middle Pro tier inverts to a solid dark card, an enterprise contact strip, a full feature-comparison table, and a clean FAQ. The whole thing reads like a premium dev-tool / design-tool pricing page.

## Estilo Visual
Use a light, warm, editorial palette. Background paper #fbfbfa (warm off-white). Primary text/ink #0a0a0b (near-black). Single accent: electric indigo #4f37ff (used only on the Pro CTA button, the POPULAR badge, the -20% annual savings pill, active check icons, the Pro column underline in the table, and ::selection highlight). Borders are 'hairline': rgba(10,10,11,0.10), 1px. Pure white #ffffff is used for elevated chips, the enterprise strip and the comparison-table surface. The highlighted Pro card inverts: solid #0a0a0b background with paper-colored text and muted paper/45-60 secondary text. Texture: a faint dotted 'grain' via radial-gradient(rgba(10,10,11,0.035) 0.5px, transparent 0.5px) at 4px x 4px, applied to hero, comparison and footer sections. Fonts: 'Inter' (weights 400/500/600/700) for all UI/body; 'Instrument Serif' italic for the single emphasized headline word ('imagination'); 'JetBrains Mono' for tabular numbers (prices, counts). Apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to prices. Headings are large, tight tracking (about -0.02em to -0.03em); body text sits at ink/50-70 opacity. Buttons are rounded-full with a subtle hover lift (translate-y -1px). Antialiased, optimizeLegibility.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky top nav
A sticky top header (top:0, z-50) with a translucent paper/80 background and backdrop-blur, a hairline bottom border. Inside, a 64px-tall row at max-w-6xl: left = brand lockup (a 28px rounded-md solid ink square holding a small white square/library glyph + the wordmark 'Promptbook' in 15px semibold tight tracking). Center (desktop only, md:flex) = nav links 'Library / Templates / Pricing / Docs' at 13.5px, ink/60, with the current 'Pricing' link in full ink. Right = a ghost 'Sign in' text link (sm+) and a solid-ink rounded-full 'Start free' pill button (13px, paper text, hover lift).

### Hero / headline
A centered hero section with the dotted grain texture and a hairline bottom border, ~80px top padding. Top: a small rounded-full pill chip (white bg, hairline border) with a tiny indigo dot and the label '2,400+ curated design prompts'. Then a big headline (40px mobile, 58px desktop, semibold, leading ~1.05, tracking -0.03em): 'Pricing that scales with your imagination' where the final word 'imagination' is set in Instrument Serif italic, normal weight, to create editorial contrast. Below: a ~max-w-xl subhead at 15-16.5px, ink/55, e.g. 'One library of battle-tested design prompts, components, and full UI flows. Generate shippable interfaces from plain language. Start free, upgrade when the canvas fills up.'

### Billing toggle
A quiet monthly/annual switch centered under the subhead: the word 'Monthly' (active = full ink), a custom pill switch (52px wide, 28px tall, white bg, hairline border) with a solid-ink circular knob that slides ~24px on toggle (transition cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)), then the word 'Annual' (inactive = ink/45) followed by a small indigo-tinted savings pill 'minus 20%'. Toggling fades the tier prices (opacity transition) and swaps each price to its annual value, and swaps the 'Billed monthly.' note to 'Billed annually.' Implement with role=switch + aria-checked for accessibility.

### Pricing tiers (the core pricing layout)
The pricing layout is a 3-up tier grid built as a single bordered, rounded-2xl container with a 1px hairline 'gap-px' grid so the cards share thin dividers (the gap is a thin black-10% line, not a gutter). On desktop lg:grid-cols-3; on tablet/mobile it collapses to one column at max-w-md. Three tiers, each a flex column with 32px padding: (1) STARTER, paper bg, a small outline 'tag' icon top-right, copy 'For solo makers exploring the canvas.', price '$0/mo' with the big number in JetBrains Mono semibold ~46px, note 'Free forever, no card.', a ghost rounded-full 'Start free' button (ink border), then a check-list of 4 features (ink/40 check icons): '40 prompt generations / mo', 'Full prompt library access', '1 infinite canvas', 'Community support'. (2) PRO, the HIGHLIGHTED middle card: solid ink (#0a0a0b) background with paper text, an indigo 'POPULAR' badge pinned top-right, copy 'For designers shipping real product UI.', price '$24/mo' (annual $19), note 'Billed monthly.', a solid INDIGO rounded-full 'Get Pro' CTA, and 5 features with INDIGO check icons: 'Unlimited generations', 'Unlimited canvases', 'Component + full-flow export', 'Coding-agent skill (Claude / Cursor)', 'Priority generation queue'. (3) TEAM, paper bg, a small outline 'users' icon, copy 'For studios designing together.', price '$79/mo' (annual $63), note 'Per workspace, up to 5 seats.', a ghost 'Start team trial' button, and 5 features: 'Everything in Pro', 'Shared canvases + libraries', 'Brand prompt presets', 'Roles + admin controls', 'SSO & priority support'. All prices carry data-m/data-a attributes so the toggle can swap monthly/annual values.

### Enterprise strip
Directly below the tier grid (visually fused, lg:mt-px so it abuts the cards), a wide white rounded-2xl hairline strip: left = a 40px rounded-xl solid-ink icon tile (building glyph) + a label 'Enterprise' (14px semibold) and a one-line description 'Unlimited seats, custom models, on-prem options, dedicated support.' Right = a ghost rounded-full 'Contact sales' button with a trailing arrow icon. Stacks vertically on mobile, row on sm+.

### Comparison table
A 'Compare every plan' section (dotted grain bg, hairline border) with a centered heading (28-34px, tracking -0.02em) and a tiny subhead 'Hairline-clean, no asterisks.'. The table sits in a white rounded-2xl hairline container, overflow-x-auto (min-width ~560px so it scrolls on mobile). Columns: Feature | Starter | Pro | Team. The Pro column header is emphasized (full ink, semibold) with a short 2px indigo underline bar pinned to the top of that cell. Rows use hairline dividers (divide-ink/7) and are a mix of values and check/dash icons: value rows ('Monthly generations' 40 / Unlimited / Unlimited; 'Infinite canvases' 1 / Unlimited / Shared; 'Support' Community / Priority / Dedicated) and boolean rows where included = a check icon (indigo in the Pro column, ink/45 elsewhere) and excluded = a thin minus/dash icon at ink/25. Boolean rows: 'Full prompt library', 'Component & flow export', 'Coding-agent skill', 'Shared brand presets', 'SSO & admin roles'.

### FAQ accordion
A 'Questions, answered' section at max-w-3xl (hairline border). Centered heading, then a list of native <details>/<summary> accordion items separated by hairline dividers (divide-ink/8) with a top+bottom border-y. Each summary is 15px medium with a plus icon (ink/40) on the right that rotates 45deg to an x when open (group-open:rotate-45). The first item is open by default. Answer text is 14px, ink/55, relaxed leading. Questions: 'What counts as a generation?', 'Can I switch plans or cancel anytime?', 'Does the free plan really stay free?', 'Do you offer student or startup discounts?' Keep the answer voice warm and human (e.g. 'Ping us and we'll sort it together.').

### Footer
A multi-column footer (dotted grain bg, no bottom border). Left = the brand lockup repeated + a one-line tagline 'The design prompt library and canvas. Idea to shippable UI, in plain language.' Right = 3 link columns under 12px uppercase tracked-wide ink/40 headers: Product (Library / Canvas / Pricing), Resources (Docs / Changelog / FAQ), Company (About / Privacy / Terms). A hairline divider then a bottom bar: copyright '© 2026 Promptbook. All rights reserved.' on the left and X / GitHub / Discord icon links on the right, all ink/40 with hover-to-ink.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Inverted highlighted Pro card — The middle pricing tier flips from the light paper scheme to a solid near-black (#0a0a0b) card with paper-colored text, an indigo 'POPULAR' badge, an indigo CTA, and indigo check icons. This single inversion is what carries the visual hierarchy of the whole pricing layout.
Make exactly the middle (Pro) tier a solid ink #0a0a0b card with paper #fbfbfa text and muted paper/45-60 secondary text. Pin an indigo (#4f37ff) rounded-full 'POPULAR' badge to the top-right. Give it a solid indigo CTA button (not a ghost outline like the side tiers) and tint its feature check icons indigo. Keep its corners flush within the shared rounded-2xl gap-px grid so it reads as one continuous card row with a darker center.

### Hairline gap-px card grid — The three tiers are not separate floating cards with gutters; they're a single rounded-2xl bordered container whose grid uses a 1px gap filled by a 10%-black line, so the cards are divided by hairlines and share one outer border. This is the signature 'frameless, hairline-clean' look.
Build the tier row as one container: rounded-2xl + outer hairline border + overflow-hidden, with a CSS grid whose background is rgba(10,10,11,0.10) and whose cells use gap-px so the background shows through as 1px divider lines between cards. Each card fills its cell with its own (paper or ink) background. On mobile collapse to a single column (cards stack with the same hairline dividers).

### Animated billing toggle with price swap — A custom pill switch that slides a solid-ink knob and, on toggle, fades each tier price out and back in while swapping monthly to annual numbers (driven by data-m / data-a attributes) and flipping the 'Billed monthly/annually' note plus an active-label color change.
Implement a role=switch button (52x28px, white bg, hairline border) with an absolutely-positioned 20px ink knob that translateX(24px) on toggle. On click: toggle aria-checked, slide the knob, swap the active label color (ink vs ink/45), and for every element with class .price fade opacity to 0, swap textContent to its data-a (annual) or data-m (monthly) value after ~130ms, then fade back to 1. Also rewrite any .bill-note text between 'Billed monthly.' and 'Billed annually.' Use tabular-nums on prices so digits don't shift width.

### Boolean feature cells (check vs dash) — In the comparison table, included features show a check icon (indigo in the Pro column, muted ink elsewhere) and excluded features show a thin minus/dash icon at ink/25, giving an instantly scannable yes/no matrix without text.
In each boolean comparison row, render an included cell as a small filled check SVG (text-accent indigo for the Pro column, text-ink/45 for Starter/Team) and an excluded cell as a thin horizontal minus/dash SVG at text-ink/25. Center every cell. Keep icons ~15px.

## Notas Especiais
This is a frameless, responsive web page, not a fixed-dimension mockup: lay it out fluid with a centered max-w-6xl column and 24px side padding, let the pricing cards reflow 3 -> 2 -> 1 columns, keep the nav sticky and translucent, and make the comparison table horizontally scrollable on narrow screens. The look depends on restraint: keep the palette to exactly four values (paper #fbfbfa, ink #0a0a0b, white #ffffff, indigo #4f37ff), use hairline (10% black) borders rather than shadows, reserve indigo strictly for the Pro tier and active/included states, and use the serif italic on only one headline word. No em-dashes in any copy; keep FAQ answers warm and human.
